create.name: Vajrayana Institute
create.bio:
Vajrayana Institute is a Tibetan Buddhist centre in Ashfield, in Sydney's inner west, belonging to the FPMT network that Lama Thubten Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche started. Its community dates from the early 1980s, when it met in Newtown under Ven. Roger Kunsang, before moving to its present house with a stupa garden, gompa, library and bookshop. Since 2003 its resident teacher has been Geshe Ngawang Samten, a Lharampa geshe of Sera Monastery who previously taught Gelug philosophy in Sarnath.

The centre runs its programme on donations rather than fees. Four guided meditation sessions each week, led by Wai Cheong Kok, Alan Marsh and Venerable Jampa Dekyi, mix breath-focused and analytical meditation and are open to beginners, in the gompa and over Zoom. Alongside them come study courses with Geshe Samten, weekend lam-rim retreats with optional stays on site, and pujas. Members support the work and receive access to Vajrayana TV, its on-demand teaching library, while hundreds of past talks are free to hear on its website and YouTube channel.

courses.title: Lam Rim Retreat
courses.description: A two-day weekend retreat led by senior teacher Wai Cheong Kok on the opening contemplations of the graduated path, such as precious human life, impermanence, refuge and karma, with guided sessions, short talks and discussion. Lunch is included and rooms at the centre can be booked separately.

courses.title: Monday Meditation
courses.description: An evening group sit with Wai Cheong Kok combining breath awareness with analytical meditation, suited to newcomers and regular meditators, at the centre or streamed.

courses.title: Sunday Meditation
courses.description: A Sunday morning guided session with Venerable Jampa Dekyi, held in Ashfield and on Zoom, joining calm breathing practice with reflective meditation.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Monthly or yearly membership at several levels, which keeps the donation-based programme going and brings a welcome pack of books, a bookshop discount, library use and access to Vajrayana TV.
courses.price: Snow Lion $10 per month; Dharmachakra $20 per month; Family $30 per month; Triple Gem $40 per month; Wish Fulfilling Jewel $90 per month

free_resources.title: Listen to Teachings
free_resources.description: An archive of audio recordings from past courses at the centre, most of them by Geshe Samten, on texts such as the Heart Sutra, Nagarjuna's Precious Garland and Shantideva's ninth chapter.

free_resources.title: Learn to Meditate
free_resources.description: An introduction to meditation with three short guided recordings, one for inner calm and two for loving kindness towards oneself and others.
